newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to meet budget team 5pm (2200 GMT) - McCurry.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to meet budget team 5pm (2200 GMT) - McCurry.

text.p: President Bill Clinton plans to meet his economic advisers at 5 p.m. EST (2200 GMT) to review the status of budget discussions with Republican congressional budget experts, the White House said Friday.

White House spokesman Mike McCurry said the purpose of the meeting was to "review the work that's been done over the last two weeks and look ahead to the next two weeks (and) the work we're going to be doing with members of Congress to continue our effort to balance the budget."

McCurry said the White House was pleased with the latest Labor Department report on the nation's employment picture, which showed that joblessness edged down to 5.2 percent last month from 5.3 percent in February.

"It shows a healthy economy continuing to produce jobs, continuing to lower the nation's unemployment rate, continuing the economic progress that's been achieved in great measure because of the economic program the president launched and fought for in 1993," the spokesman said.
McCurry added that the data also served as a reminder "of how important it is to balance the budget by a date certain."
